title: Faculty Info Lecturer on Education (2005-2025) Degrees Ph.D., University of Virginia Areas of Expertise Counseling and Mental Health Social Emotional Learning
bio: Jacqueline Zeller's clinical interests focus on self-care and systems of care — including prevention and intervention efforts in schools and promoting resiliency in children. She has worked as a therapist in a variety of settings, including residential and day treatment centers, outpatient clinics, and schools.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
